app.name: Painfold
app.tagline: Find what hurts your customers, without exposing who they are.

start.headline: Find what hurts your customers. Without exposing who they are.
start.subline: Start by cleaning your feedback file: emails, phone numbers, IBANs and more are removed right here in your browser.
start.choose: Choose a CSV or Excel file
start.privacy: Your file is never uploaded. It stays in this browser.
start.dropOverlay: Drop to open. Nothing is uploaded.

importErrors.empty-file: This file is empty. Choose a file with a header row and at least one row of feedback.
importErrors.file-too-large: This file is larger than 50 MB. Split it into smaller files and clean them one at a time.
importErrors.no-rows: This file only has a header row. Add rows of feedback, or choose another file.
importErrors.too-many-rows: This file has more than 50,000 rows. Split it into smaller files and clean them one at a time.
importErrors.unsupported-format: Painfold reads CSV and XLSX files. Export your data in one of those formats and choose it again.
importErrors.legacy-excel: This is an old Excel file (.xls). Open it in Excel, save it as .xlsx or .csv, then choose it again.
importErrors.unreadable: This file could not be read. It may be damaged or password-protected. Try exporting it again.

file.ragged: 1 row had a different number of cells than the header and was filled in. | {n} rows had a different number of cells than the header and were filled in.

columns.heading: Choose what to check
columns.help: Check: searched for personal data. Keep as is: copied to the cleaned file without checking. Drop: left out of the cleaned file.
columns.masked: Values hidden because this column is dropped
columns.summary: Cleaned file: {columns}, {checked} checked, {kept} kept as is, {dropped} dropped
columns.noFeedback: No column looks like feedback. Mark the one that holds it with the circle at the start of its row.

preview.heading: Show first {n} rows
preview.note: Only the columns that stay in the cleaned file.
preview.label: Preview of the first rows

find.failed: Something went wrong while checking the file. Try again, or reload the page.

review.heading: {findings} in {rows}
review.noFindings: No findings. Select any text that should be removed and press M, or continue.

note.title: {type}, row {row}
note.copies: Appears in 1 row. Removing it replaces it with {placeholder}. | Appears in {n} rows. Removing it replaces every copy with {placeholder}.
note.nothingSelected: Select a finding to review it.
note.formOf: Looks like a form of “{marked}”, which you marked. Removing it replaces it with {placeholder}.

mark.heading: Mark “{text}” as personal data
mark.noSelection: Select the missed text in a row first, then press M.
mark.overlap: The selection overlaps a finding. Select only the missed text.
mark.done: {type} marked in 1 row. | {type} marked in {n} rows.
mark.forms: 1 possible form to review. | {n} possible forms to review.

review.willRemove: 1 not reviewed will be removed. | {n} not reviewed will be removed.
review.limits: Automatic detection can miss personal data. Review the results before sharing the cleaned file. Painfold helps with data protection but is not legal advice and does not by itself make your processing GDPR compliant.
review.inRows: In 1 row. Removing it replaces it with {placeholder}. | In {n} rows. Removing it replaces every copy with {placeholder}.

finished.title: All findings are reviewed.
finished.body: {removed} removed, {kept} kept. Next: download the cleaned file and the cleaning report.

review.moreRows: And 1 more row. | And {n} more rows.

privacy.notice: Your file is never uploaded. It stays in this browser.

download.heading: Your cleaned file is ready.
download.nothingRemoved: Nothing was found or marked, so the text is unchanged.
download.notReviewed: Includes 1 finding that was not reviewed. | Includes {n} findings that were not reviewed.
download.kept: 1 finding was kept. | {n} findings were kept.
download.mapStays: The list of original values behind each placeholder stays in this browser and is gone when you close the tab.
download.reportExplain: The cleaned file holds only your data. The cleaning report lists what was replaced, with the date, the Painfold version and the limits of automatic detection.

next.title: Your file is clean.
next.body: Next in Painfold: turn it into ranked customer pains (coming in v0.3).

network.none: No data has left this browser.
network.foreign: 1 request went to another site. | {n} requests went to other sites.
network.explain: Every request this page has made since it opened. Your file is read, checked and cleaned here, and never sent anywhere.
network.allOwn: All requests went to this site ({host}): the app's own code, fonts and text.

example.caption: A support ticket, before and after cleaning
example.ticket: Bitte rufen Sie mich unter {phone} zurück oder schreiben Sie an {email}.
example.description: Example: in a support ticket, a phone number and an email address are replaced by the placeholders [PHONE_1] and [EMAIL_1].

roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.intro: Painfold helps you understand what hurts your customers. Cleaning your feedback privately is the first step.
roadmap.full: Read the full roadmap on GitHub

clean.name: Clean
clean.summary: Remove personal data from a feedback file in your browser and download the cleaned file.
points: Emails, phone numbers, IBANs and eight more kinds of personal data
Review and correct every finding before you download

names.name: Names
names.summary: Also find names and places, with a model that runs in your browser.
points: People and places in German and English
Warnings for details that identify someone indirectly
Published accuracy for every kind of personal data

jobs.name: Jobs, pains and gains
jobs.summary: See what your customers are trying to get done, what frustrates them and what they wish for.
points: Use your own AI key or a local model
See exactly what is sent before analysis starts
Every quote checked against your data

report.name: Report
report.summary: A report your team can act on in one meeting.
points: The three most important findings first
Segments and trends, when your file has them
Opportunities framed as “How might we…” questions

launch.name: Launch
launch.summary: Try Painfold in 30 seconds, or run it on your own servers.
points: A demo with ready-made results, no API key needed
A Docker image for self-hosting with a local model
